select GorevID,GorevAd from Gorevler where silindi = 0
select Ulke from HavaAlanlari where kita=@kita group by Ulke
select HavaAlaniID,HavaalaniAdi from HavaAlanlari where ulke=@ulke and kita=@kita
select HavaAlaniID,HavaalaniAdi, Kita, Ulke, Sehir from HavaAlanlari where Silindi = 0
select Kita from HavaAlanlari group by Kita
select Ulke from HavaAlanlari where Kita=@kita  group by Ulke
select HavaAlaniAdi from HavaAlanlari where  kita = @kita  and ulke =@ulke
select HavaalaniAdi from HavaAlanlari where Silindi = 0

select PersonelID,PersonelAdi,PersonelSoyadi,YetkiTipiID,YetkiliAd,Gorevler.GorevID,GorevAd from Personeller inner join Yetki on Personeller.YetkiTipiID = Yetki.YetkiliID inner join Gorevler on Gorevler.GorevID = Personeller.GorevID where personeller.Silindi = 0 and KullaniciAdi=@KullaniciAdi and KullaniciSifresi=@KullaniciSifresi
select MusteriID, MusteriAdi,MusteriSoyadi, MusteriTCKNo,Telefon,Email, Adres,SatisID  from Musteriler where Silindi = 0

select MusteriID, MusteriAdi,MusteriSoyadi, MusteriTCKNo,Telefon,Email, Adres,SatisID from Musteriler where Silindi = 0 and (MusteriAdi like @Arama  + '%' or MusteriSoyadi like @Arama  + '%' or Telefon like @Arama  + '%' or MusteriTCKNo like @Arama  + '%' or Email like @Arama + '%' )

select u.UcusID, h.HavaAlaniAdi as Nereden, ha.HavaAlaniAdi as Nereye, u.Ucret as Ucret, count(s.MusteriID) as ToplamYolcu, (u.Ucret* count(s.MusteriID)) as ToplamTutar,u.TahminiKalkis from Satis as s inner join Ucuslar as u on s.UcusKodu=u.UcusID inner join HavaAlanlari as h on u.NeredenID=h.HavaAlaniID inner join HavaAlanlari as ha on ha.HavaAlaniID=u.NereyeID where s.Silindi = 0 and u.TahminiKalkis between @tarih1 and @tarih2 group by s.UcusKodu,u.UcusID,h.HavaAlaniAdi,ha.HavaAlaniAdi,u.Ucret,u.TahminiKalkis

select s.RezervasyonID,u.UcusID, h.HavaAlaniAdi as Nereden, ha.HavaAlaniAdi as Nereye,m.MusteriID,m.MusteriAdi+' '+m.MusteriSoyadi as AdSoyad, u.Ucret as Ucret,u.TahminiKalkis, u.TahminiVaris,uc.Kontenjani,s.Silindi from Satis as s inner join Ucuslar as u on s.UcusKodu=u.UcusID inner join HavaAlanlari as h on u.NeredenID=h.HavaAlaniID inner join HavaAlanlari as ha on ha.HavaAlaniID=u.NereyeID inner join Ucaklar as uc on uc.UcakID = u.UcakID inner join Musteriler as m on s.MusteriID=m.MusteriID where s.Silindi = 0 and s.UcusKodu=@uID
select count(*) from Satis where UcusKodu=@uID

select s.RezervasyonID,u.UcusID, h.HavaAlaniAdi as Nereden, ha.HavaAlaniAdi as Nereye,m.MusteriID,m.MusteriAdi+' '+m.MusteriSoyadi as AdSoyad, u.Ucret as Ucret,u.TahminiKalkis, u.TahminiVaris,uc.Kontenjani,s.Silindi from Satis as s inner join Ucuslar as u on s.UcusKodu=u.UcusID inner join HavaAlanlari as h on u.NeredenID=h.HavaAlaniID inner join HavaAlanlari as ha on ha.HavaAlaniID=u.NereyeID inner join Ucaklar as uc on uc.UcakID = u.UcakID inner join Musteriler as m on s.MusteriID=m.MusteriID where s.Silindi = 0

select s.RezervasyonID,u.UcusID, h.HavaAlaniAdi as Nereden, ha.HavaAlaniAdi as Nereye,m.MusteriID,m.MusteriAdi+' '+m.MusteriSoyadi as AdSoyad, u.Ucret as Ucret,u.TahminiKalkis, u.TahminiVaris,uc.Kontenjani,s.Silindi from Satis as s inner join Ucuslar as u on s.UcusKodu=u.UcusID inner join HavaAlanlari as h on u.NeredenID=h.HavaAlaniID inner join HavaAlanlari as ha on ha.HavaAlaniID=u.NereyeID inner join Ucaklar as uc on uc.UcakID = u.UcakID inner join Musteriler as m on s.MusteriID=m.MusteriID where s.Silindi = 0 and m.MusteriTCKNo like @TCK+'%'
select PersonelID, (PersonelAdi + ' ' + PersonelSoyadi) as Adsoyad from Personeller where Silindi = 0 and GorevID = 1 and Uygunluk = 1
select PersonelID, (PersonelAdi + ' ' + PersonelSoyadi) as Adsoyad from Personeller where silindi = 0 and GorevID = 3 and Uygunluk = 1
select PersonelID, (PersonelAdi + ' ' + PersonelSoyadi) as Adsoyad from Personeller where silindi = 0 and GorevID = 5 and Uygunluk = 1

select p.PersonelID, p.PersonelAdi, p.PersonelSoyadi  , p.PersonelTCK,p.KullaniciAdi,p.KullaniciSifresi,p.GorevID,g.GorevAd,p.UstuID,pe.PersonelAdi +' '+pe.PersonelSoyadi as Ust, p.YetkiTipiID, y.YetkiliAd,p.Telefon,p.Mail,p.IseBaslamaTarihi,p.Adres from Personeller as p inner join Gorevler as g on g.GorevID=p.GorevID inner join Yetki as y on y.YetkiliID=p.YetkiTipiID  left join Personeller as pe on p.UstuID=pe.PersonelID where p.Silindi = 0
select PersonelID, (PersonelAdi + ' ' + PersonelSoyadi) as Adsoyad from Personeller where silindi = 0 and GorevID=@GorevID - 1

select p.PersonelID, p.PersonelAdi + ' ' + p.PersonelSoyadi as AdiSoyadi, p.PersonelTCK,p.GorevID,g.GorevAd,p.UstuID,pe.PersonelAdi +' '+pe.PersonelSoyadi as Ust, p.YetkiTipiID, y.YetkiliAd,p.Telefon,p.Mail,p.IseBaslamaTarihi,p.Adres from Personeller as p inner join Gorevler as g on g.GorevID=p.GorevID inner join Yetki as y on y.YetkiliID=p.YetkiTipiID  left join Personeller as pe on p.UstuID=pe.PersonelID where p.Silindi = 0

select p.PersonelID, p.PersonelAdi + ' ' + p.PersonelSoyadi as AdiSoyadi, p.PersonelTCK,p.GorevID,g.GorevAd,p.UstuID,pe.PersonelAdi +' '+pe.PersonelSoyadi as Ust, p.YetkiTipiID, y.YetkiliAd,p.Telefon,p.Mail,p.IseBaslamaTarihi,p.Adres from Personeller as p inner join Gorevler as g on g.GorevID=p.GorevID inner join Yetki as y on y.YetkiliID=p.YetkiTipiID  left join Personeller as pe on p.UstuID=pe.PersonelID where p.Silindi = 0 and (p.PersonelAdi + ' ' + p.PersonelSoyadi) like @Arama  + '%'  or p.PersonelTCK like @Arama +'%' or g.GorevAd like @Arama +'%' or (pe.PersonelAdi +' '+pe.PersonelSoyadi) like @Arama +'%' or y.YetkiliAd  like @Arama +'%'
